interview.question: Why were ambulance trips slower with TraffiX (240.0 s against 213.2 s)?
None of the TraffiX differences is significant with three seeds. What would you run next?

How would you measure OCR accuracy on real HR documents, given that you have only synthetic ones?

glossary.definition: Among the 50 items a model ranks highest, the share that turn out to be correct. It asks whether the top of a queue is worth a person's time.
A simple, readable rule fixed before looking at the answers, so a model has something honest to beat.
Data kept out of training and used only to test. A grouped holdout keeps whole groups (here, whole clients) apart, so the model cannot have seen anything from the groups it is tested on.
When information from the answer sneaks into the inputs, which inflates a score. A leakage test plants such a feature on purpose to check that the evaluation would catch it.
The share of the variation in an outcome that a model explains, compared with always predicting the average. 1 is perfect, 0 is no better than the average.
The starting numbers of a random process. Running a simulation with several seeds shows how much a result changes by chance; three is few.
Whether a difference is larger than chance alone would plausibly produce. A p-value under 0.05 is the usual bar for calling a difference significant.
Retrieval-augmented generation: a system first retrieves relevant documents, then a language model writes an answer from them. This site retrieves and shows the passages, without a language model.
Optical character recognition: turning an image or scan of text into machine-readable text.
Simulation of Urban Mobility: an open-source traffic simulator that models vehicles, pedestrians and signals on a road network.
Traffic Control Interface: the way a program reads and changes a running SUMO simulation.
Fixed-time signals follow a set schedule. Actuated signals extend or shorten phases when sensors see vehicles. Both are the standard baselines a new controller is compared with.
Traffic or data generated by rules instead of measured on real streets. Results on it show how a system behaves in a simulation, not in a city.
Projet de fin d'études: the final-year internship or project that completes an engineering degree in Tunisia and France.

costSafety: Set an AWS Budgets alert (and a billing alarm) before connecting anything that can charge.
Throttle requests at the API layer before any model is behind it.
Cap question length (this site already limits it to 200 characters).
Keep AWS credentials out of the browser and the repository; use IAM roles on the service side, never access keys.
Do not assume Bedrock token usage is free; check current pricing before enabling it.
